definitions.explanation: The earliest period of human history before the development of writing and civilization, when humans lived as hunter-gatherers.

examples.japanese: {原始時代|げんしじだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{狩猟|しゅりょう}→狩猟：13507_shuryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}していた→生活する：01839_seikatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: People in prehistoric times lived by hunting.

examples.japanese: {原始時代|げんしじだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Tools from the primitive era are displayed in the museum.

examples.japanese: {原始時代|げんしじだい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧にしてきた。
examples.english: Since prehistoric times, humans have enriched their lives by using fire.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{原始|げんし}→原始：00067_genshi⟧ (primitive; primeval) and ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧ (era; age). Used in history, anthropology, and general discussion to refer to the earliest stage of human existence. Sometimes used loosely or figuratively to describe something extremely outdated.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {原始時代|げんしじだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧: primitive humans
- {原始時代|げんしじだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: life in prehistoric times
- {原始時代|げんしじだい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: since prehistoric times
- {原始時代|げんしじだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧: prehistoric ruins

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{先史時代|せんしじだい}→先史時代：26438_senshijidai⟧: prehistoric era — a more academic term specifically meaning the period before written records
- ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧: ancient times — a later period when civilizations had already formed, with writing and organized society
- {石器時代|せっきじだい}: Stone Age — refers specifically to the period defined by the use of stone tools
